rationale: Consolidates eight duplicate page-head/section patterns into one shared primitive while adding accessible names and ARIA attributes across 45 files and updating DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; all changes are visual/accessibility consistency with no data or API impact and are fully revertible.

signals.blast_radius: Eight local page-head/section/notice copies consolidated into one shared primitive across dashboard, library, brief, drafts, campaigns, kits, and team pages; ARIA attributes added to inputs, tablists, stepper steps, and toggles; E2E selector names updated in multiple test files.
signals.unresolved: Label text default (current placeholder as visible label, with proposed default: yes) and shared primitive component names (proposed: PageHead, Section, Notice) — both have confident proposed defaults and neither changes the file list.
signals.irreversibility: Fully revertible via git; no data migration, no released behavior change, no persisted schema — E2E selector updates are code changes handled per task, captured before and after.
